label: different_practice
evidence: We DO NOT collect, store or use any personal information while you visit, download or upgrade our products
we may disclose your personal information according to your wish or regulations by law
reason: Statement 2 concerns collection while visiting, downloading, or upgrading. Statement 1 concerns disclosure of personal information the user submits, on permission or legal request. The action and data differ.

label: unresolved
evidence: These tools place persistent cookies in your browser to identify you as a unique user the next time you visit our website
We do not use cookies for tracking purposes
reason: Persistent cookies identify returning users for analytics, which arguably is tracking. The policy does not define tracking purposes or say whether analytics counts, so the conflict rests on vague wording.

label: deny
evidence: We do not to our knowledge collect information, or ask for personal information
You need to be over a certain age to play our Games or use our services
reason: Statement 1 is a general scope sentence about collection. Statement 2 carves out users under the minimum age, from whom the text says no information is collected.

label: different_practice
evidence: Typically, we do not collect Personal Data through your use of the Online Services.
that does not directly identify you
reason: Statement 2 restricts Personal Data. The same passage says the services collect Other Data such as device and usage data, which is the data statement 1 describes.

label: different_practice
evidence: Wanelo may use Personal Information and other information about you to create anonymized and aggregated information
Personal Information that you may provide for a friend or colleague
reason: Statement 1 shares anonymized data derived from information about the user. Statement 2 limits personal information the user supplies about a friend. The data differ.

label: different_practice
evidence: After your roadside assistance service request has been closed, your current location will no longer be shared with or visible to the roadside assistance provider or us
With User's opt-in consent, the AAA Mobile App may use the location data to send information related to AAA discounts
reason: Statement 2 ends location sharing set up for a roadside service request. Statement 1 is a separate opt-in use of background location for discount notifications, with a different purpose.

label: misread
evidence: EU data subjects retain their full rights to be informed of the purposes of our processing activities at collection
reason: Statement 2 states a user's right to be informed. It does not prohibit sharing personal information with client organizations or third parties.

label: misread
evidence: We agree that we will not sell, rent, or trade your email address to any unaffiliated third-party without your permission
FarmersOnly does not sell, rent, or otherwise provide your Personally Identifiable Information to third parties for marketing purposes
reason: Statement 1 is a promise not to sell email addresses without permission. It does not affirmatively permit any sale, so no permission conflicts with statement 2.

label: allow
evidence: We will not collect additional categories of Personal Data or use the Personal Data we collected for materially different, unrelated, or incompatible purposes without providing you notice
We will only process your Personal Data if we have a lawful basis for doing so
reason: Statement 1 permits processing for the listed purposes on stated lawful bases. Statement 2 restricts only new data categories or materially different purposes without notice, which excludes the described processing.

label: deny
evidence: will not be collected or otherwise used by Wanelo or any other Third Parties for any other purpose
Wanelo may use Personal Information to create non-identifiable information
reason: Statement 1 lists general uses of personal information, including aggregation and marketing. Statement 2 specifically limits information provided about a friend to sending the requested content.

label: different_practice
evidence: When you save photo or tag such photo by your or your child name and/or age via our Apps
We do not collect, store, use or process such information in any manner or way and for any purpose
reason: Statement 2 refers to photo tags stored on the device. Statement 1 concerns name and email received through Facebook or Google login. The data differ.

label: misread
evidence: This page is used to inform visitors regarding our policies
We will not use or share your information with anyone except as described in this Privacy Policy
reason: Statement 1 only describes the purpose of the page and permits no practice. Statement 2 limits use and sharing to what the policy describes.

label: no_overlap
evidence: The information that I request will be retained on your device and is not collected by me in any way
The Personal Information that I collect is used for providing and improving the Service
reason: Statement 1 governs use of information the developer collects, such as log data. Statement 2 says requested information stays on the device and is never collected, so it never falls under statement 1.

label: deny
evidence: We do not intentionally gather Personal Data about visitors who are under the age of 13
reason: Statement 1 lets users submit personal data through website forms. Statement 2 carves out children under 13, from whom the text says personal data is not intentionally gathered.

label: misread
evidence: This includes the right to request that BNEA disclose the following information
The categories of Personal Data about the user that BNEA otherwise shared or disclosed
reason: Statement 2 lists information users may request under their access right. It is not a prohibition. Statement 1 only states responsibility for onward transfers.

label: different_practice
evidence: These partners process your data only at and according to our instructions
The Service includes features from our partners, such as social media interaction tools and in-game advertising.
reason: The text separates service providers acting on instructions from advertising and social media partners whose features run under their own policies. The statements concern different recipients.

label: allow
evidence: This data is synced with the server and used as an identifier, but is not processed or shared in any way
we will have access to certain information such as your name and email address
reason: Statement 2 itself says the login data is synced and used as an identifier. Its prohibition covers further processing or sharing, which does not include the access in statement 1.

label: deny
evidence: we will not provide additional information to such third parties that enables such third parties to identify you
We may share information with third parties.
reason: Statement 1 generally permits sharing with third parties. Statement 2 carves out third parties such as Huq that receive anonymous data, to whom identifying information will not be provided.

label: deny
evidence: We do not knowingly collect personal or other information from children
If you are younger than thirteen (13) years of age, you should not use Our Products and Services
reason: Statement 1 describes identifying information users provide. Statement 2 carves out children under 13, from whom the text says information is not knowingly collected.

label: deny
evidence: We will only access your location while you are using the Application or the Site and provided you have opted in to activate this feature
reason: Statement 1 permits location access with consent. Statement 2 narrows access to times the app or site is in use, so access with consent outside use is prohibited.
